reflectionQuestion: Where is your favorite quiet place, and what do you notice when you sit still there?
title: The Bench and the Spider Web
theme: peace, quiet, feeling safe and still
reflectionText:
Suki found something wonderful just sitting still in her own backyard. A spider web full of raindrops, a robin singing the same song over and over, a single drop of water letting go.

Sometimes the quietest moments are the fullest ones. Peace isn't always far away — sometimes it's waiting right outside the back door.
